description: Compare Site A against Site B on page existence, content and visual regression. Charged upfront. Paid in USDC (the 402 challenge names the network), or from a prepaid balance when the request carries Authorization: Bearer dck_…: 0.02 USD per page for the first 1000 pages and 0.01 USD per page beyond. maxPages is optional: a ceiling, not a reservation. A job is priced on the pages it compares (the urls list, or the pages discovery finds, at most maxPages), the challenge names the count, and there is no page limit. A single-page comparison is a urls list with one pair (preferred), or maxPages: 1 with the page URLs as sourceUrl and targetUrl; either is priced as one page and runs no discovery. One single-page comparison per client address per day is free when the request carries no payment credential and no prepaid key: the response is the normal 201 with sample: true and pagesCharged: 0, and once the allowance is used the same request is challenged as usual. A sample report over three pages, produced by this API, is at https://difficat.com/agents/sample/report.json. The discovery that prices a job without urls is not charged; discover_pages is a separate, optional purchase for callers who want the page list itself. Set maxPriceUsd to refuse a job priced above your budget before any challenge. A settled charge is final: cancelling, a failed job or partial results do not reduce it. recover_comparison returns a job whose result was lost, given the same payment credential. Then wait_for_comparison holds until the job ends (timeoutSeconds, at most 300), or give callbackUrl to receive one JSON POST when it does; a terminal status carries summary.issuesBySeverity, the verdict. Call get_report with failedOnly: true first for the pages that failed, then the rest paged with offset and limit. Answers with jobId, jobToken, status and pagesCharged, plus sample on the free run.

callbackUrl.description: Optional https URL that receives one JSON POST when the job ends (jobId, status, summary, links; never the jobToken), a nudge to read the job. Public hosts only, no redirects followed, retried twice; delivery never affects the job.

maxPages.description: Optional ceiling on the pages compared and charged for. The job is priced on the pages it compares: the urls list, or the pages discovery finds, at most this many. There is no page limit.

maxPriceUsd.description: Optional spend cap in USD. A job priced above it is refused before any challenge, so an auto-paying client is never asked for more.

sourceAuth.description: HTTP basic auth for Site A.

sourceUrl.description: Site A, the reference site (full URL). Required unless urls is given.

targetAuth.description: HTTP basic auth for Site B.

targetUrl.description: Site B, the migrated site. Omit to capture screenshots of Site A only.

threshold.description: Visual diff tolerance as a fraction from 0 (exact) to 1: 0.05 means 5%. The web app takes a percentage; the API does not.

urls.description: Explicit page pairs to compare; skips discovery and is priced per pair. One pair is a single-page comparison and needs no sourceUrl.
